scope: Bounded read-only rereview of the revised source_conversion_io.py against the three R1 WIP findings: safety exception normalization, foreign mirror collision refusal, and partial acquisition sibling tracking. No source, test, Git, Vault, network, or external-process mutation.

checks.evidence: _verify_all now retains ContractError, OSError, and StagingError while continuing checks over every held object. StagingError is converted to ContractError with its code, details, instance pointer default, and exit_code default 2. source_conversion._boundary now preserves named exception code/details/exit information for the direct API, and the AST parses successfully.

validator_mirror maps fresh nonce creation OSError to WORK_PATH_UNSAFE. RetainedTree.mkdir maps directory creation conflicts and changes to WORK_PATH_UNSAFE. RetainedTree.install maps OSError and StagingError, including differing foreign installs, to WORK_PATH_UNSAFE; an already occupied identical slot remains explicitly refused.

capture now performs a sibling stat/type/nlink prepass before reading any payload, records every safe sibling identity in directories/files, then reads payloads in a second pass. Early limit/read/parse failure therefore retains all reached sibling identities and complete directory sets for final verification; unread bytes are not claimed as captured.
The prepass preserves the bounded 8192-entry, depth-16, 16 MiB-file and 128 MiB-total limits. The extra stat pass remains bounded; no independent performance blocker was found.
